strings.subtitle: — Bagarapim fail —
strings.no_file: I no gat fail i makim
strings.dnd_hint: (o pulim fail i go insait long dispela windo)
strings.dnd_unavailable: Pulim na lusim i no stap. Yuzim dispela baten i stap daunbilo.
strings.shred_button: B A G A R A P I M
strings.ssd_warning:
Was gut! Long SSD, dispela rot bilong raitim antap i no promis bagarap long wanem TRIM.
Dispela program i bilong HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Bai ol i raitim antap long fail "{name}" na bai ol i rausim.

Go het?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.report_title: ✅  OL I RAITIM ANTAP NA RAUSIM FAIL
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS arapela data strem (ADS) i no wokim.
• Buk bilong USN i no klinim.
• Kobi bilong seido na sinkronais bilong klaut
  (OneDrive na arapela) i no bagarap.
strings.step_rename: Senisim nem i go long GUID
strings.status_full: Olgeta samting insait i raitim antap wantaim ziro. I no inap kisim bek — tul bai lukim ziro tasol.
strings.status_fast: Het, tel na 4 MB lain i raitim antap. Arapela i no bin pilim, tasol long wanem gat hul, kisim bek olgeta long ol tul bilong kastama i no inap. Bilong ol dokumen i hait, yuzim FULL mode.
strings.status_empty: Fail i empti, raitim antap i no nid. Rausim pinis.
strings.error_permission: I no inap go long fail. Ating i op long arapela program. Klosim na traim gen.
strings.error_not_found: I no painim fail. Ating i rausim pinis.
strings.error_is_symlink: Dispela emi simbolik link. Link i no inap bagarap — fail i go long en bai stap gut.
strings.error_reparse: Dispela emi fail bilong ples (OneDrive o kain olsem). Data bilong en i stap long klaut, i no long disk — i no gat samting bilong bagarap hia.
strings.error_not_file: Dispela i no fail (folda o arapela samting). Lusim wanpela fail.
strings.error_hardlinks: Dispela fail i gat arapela strongpela link ({n} olgeta). Strongpela link i no gat het — olgeta nem i wankain. Sapos yu bagarap long rot nau, data bai raitim antap na katim i go long 32 byte, tasol hap i stap yet bai inap go long en long arapela link. Rausim olgeta link pastaim.
strings.error_compressed:
Fail i kompresim, haitim o i bun. Raitim antap wantaim ziro i no promis bagarap bilong olpela data long wanem NTFS i holim ol long narakain rot.

Rausim dispela atrap: kliki rait → Propotis → Advans → rausim mak long Kompresim na/o Haitim. Nau, mekim SHREDDER gen.
